title: Create Profile
description:
Create the session summary prompt profile that specifies both prompting instructions and session context configuration.
See [the Generate Summary Overview section of the Introduction](/server/sessions/introduction/#generate-summary-overview) for detailed guidance on creating prompt profiles to be used for generating session summaries.

mode.title: return earliest or latest events as defined

event_limit.title: only keep the specified number of events if this is greater than zero

duration_limit_ms.title: only keep events within the specified time duration from the beginning or end time

start_timestamp.description: If specified, the event limit and duration limit will be applied to the time beginning at this timestamp.
start_timestamp.title: apply event_limit and duration_limit_ms to the time beginning at start_timestamp

end_timestamp.description: If specified, only events before this timestamp will be included in the context.

include.description: Controls the session context elements to include, takes precedence over individual inclusion fields. Can be 'user', 'org', 'location', 'device'. If not specified and not excluded, all context elements are included.

exclude.description: Controls the session context elements to exclude, takes precedence over individual exclusion fields. Can be 'user', 'org', 'location', 'device'. If not specified and not excluded, all context elements are included.

exclude_types.description: Event types to exclude from the context. Valid event types: `navigate`, `click`, `dead-click`, `error-click`, `rage-click`, `input-change`, `network-error`, `console-error`, `mouse-thrash`, `highlight`, `copy`, `paste`, `element-seen`. See the [AI Session Summary API documentation](/anywhere/activation/ai-session-summary-api/#includingexcluding-event-types) for detailed descriptions of each event type.

include_types.description: Event types to include in the context. If specified, only these event types will be included. Valid event types: `navigate`, `click`, `dead-click`, `error-click`, `rage-click`, `input-change`, `network-error`, `console-error`, `mouse-thrash`, `highlight`, `copy`, `paste`, `element-seen`. See the [AI Session Summary API documentation](/anywhere/activation/ai-session-summary-api/#includingexcluding-event-types) for detailed descriptions of each event type.

llm.description: Configuration used to select the LLM model and related prompt and inference options.

pre_prompt.description: Text to be included in the Generative AI prompt before including the contextual representation of the requested session.

post_prompt.description: Text to be included in the Generative AI prompt after including the contextual representation of the requested session.

temperature.description: Controls the randomness of text generated by a large language model.

example.title: SessionSummary
example.description: Structured output for the LLM response

response_schema.description:
Defines the JSON schema for the model's output. The LLM response is highly reliable at conforming to this schema, ensuring a structured and predictable format.

This implementation adheres to the JSON Schema specification, except that 1) All `type` values must be capitalized (e.g., `OBJECT`, `STRING`, etc.) and 2) The `$schema` and `$id` properties are not supported and must be omitted from the schema definition.

See the Introduction for a [detailed example](/server/sessions/introduction/#example-response-schema).

name.description: The display name of the profile.

id.description: Client defined ID representing this profile to be used in profile management API calls and to specify when performing session analysis.
